text: In these scenes I feel a blend of curiosity and anticipation. The first image invites me into a world where knowledge is formally welcomed, perhaps just before a talk or a meeting—there is a sense of readiness, a quiet before an intellectual gathering. The second image puts me before a vibrant display of research and development, surrounded by color and bold text. Here, I feel energised and inspired; I am reminded that thinking, learning, and innovation are living processes, always evolving. The modern setting provokes both awe and the desire to participate—to ask questions and be part of the conversation.
